reviews.text:
We are incredibly grateful to Dr. Joe Keane and the whole team at Blackpool Vet Hospital for saving our cat’s eye. ❤️

Our cat was at serious risk of losing his eye due to a severe corneal ulcer, and we were initially advised by other vets that surgery or removal of the eye might be necessary. We were devastated. Thankfully, we sought a second opinion from Dr. Joe at the last minute, and his experience, expertise, and professional judgement made all the difference.

Dr. Joe was incredibly patient, listened carefully to all our concerns, answered every question, and even followed up on our cat’s progress a few days later. He has continued to be so helpful and reassuring whenever we’ve had questions.

The entire team and staff are also wonderfully friendly, caring, responsive, and professional.

After almost 2 months, our cat’s eye has recovered remarkably well and is nearly fully healed — something we honestly feared might never happen. We couldn’t be more thankful. 🥹❤️

A huge thank you to Dr. Joe and the entire team for their dedication, kindness, and professionalism. We would definitely recommend Blackpool Vet Hospital, and especially Dr. Joe, to anyone looking for exceptional care for their beloved pets. 🐾

Amazing place! Called on a Sunday evening about my 12 week old kitten who had flu symptoms. After being dismissed by our own vets out of hours service (“sounds like the flu, bring him in tomorrow”) plus another cork based out of hours service I called Blackpool and they said I’d be able to come in right away. Turns out my little boy had 40 fever and was really sick. The vet was so caring and helpful. And the price was super reasonable. Out of hours service plus treatment plus meds for at home was in total only 10€ more than the basic emergency fee at my own vets out of hours service would have been! Honestly if anyone ever needs emergency care for their animals, this is the place to go to!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We would like to express our deepest gratitude to Blackpool Veterinary Hospital for all the care, attention, and professionalism we received while our beloved Melissa was being treated. ❤️🐾

At a time when we were very worried and anxious, we were welcomed by a kind, compassionate, and highly professional team. Every bit of care made a difference to us and to Melissa’s recovery.

We sincerely thank all the professionals involved for their kindness, dedication, and for treating Melissa with such respect and care.

Our family is truly grateful for everything you did. We highly recommend Blackpool Veterinary Hospital with complete confidence.

May God bless the entire team and continue to give you wisdom, strength, and love as you care for so many animals and their families. 🙏❤️🐾
Excellent service, the receptionist was super kind and the doctor was very attentive and patient with us, even though he was using a translator to communicate with us.
Very friendly

First time today at Blackpool vet  as my vet was closed cannot praise them enough from reception to the vet himself I think his name is Joe  if I ever need a vet again out of hours  it will definitely be Blackpool
Really great practice, always feel well looked after with my pets
Brilliant vet Cathal , front girls so kind and friendly for a vety busy place. Operated on my 11 year old doggy and shes as good as new , kept in regular contact with us as she had to stay over night
Great service amazing staff

Almost €300 more than what I had been told. They did not clean up my pet after the operation and it took me days to get all of the blood, goo, and other things out and their coat was very matted from everything sticking to them. Staff were nice but I feel they were a bit distracted - victims of their own success.
Couldn't ask for a nicer vets.

Excellent vet. Huge difference between here and a basic vet. Really good information and advice. Our vet was talking about putting our dog down. Blackpool never mentioned it. Dog has never been better.

Incredibly caring team that dealt with our dogs issue efficiently and with consideration. It was out of hours, quick and we still had him home that night. He was like a new dog the day after, so happy again. Thanks so much to everyone!

Thank you to Joe for getting our lab X Ollie in for a CT scan a few months back on the day we brought him in, with his expertise and regular meds Ollie had a bit of extra quality time , he passed away at home peacefully today and he fought to the end.
Great friendly vets .lovely staff

I started with these vets in 2019 and they saved my dog Ella, she had an autoimmune disorder and needed a blood transfusion and without Joe and Cathal she would not of survived as I was after dealing with 5+ other vet practices who never found the issue.

I highly recommend this practice, they go above and beyond for every single animal. This is the only vets I use and will recommend.

Thanks so much for giving me and my Ella and extra 6 years, I will be forever grateful 🥰

I just wanted to say thank you from the bottom of my heart for all your help and kindness. This is a street cat I’ve been caring for, and I also look after other cats and have my own at home, so your support truly means a lot to me.
Everything went well, and I’m so relieved and grateful. I honestly don’t have the right words to say how much your help has meant to me.
The clinic is lovely. Dr Michael, the receptionist, and everyone there were so kind and caring. I felt very comfortable and supported. Even though the cat is very shy and not used to people yet, he was treated with so much patience and kindness.
Thank you again for everything  it really means more to me than I can say.
Anna

Thank you so much to Blackpool Veterinary Hospital for the care you provided to our dog Coco. Michael and the behind the scenes team- we will be forever grateful for the dedication, kindness and compassion shown not only to Coco but to us also, not forgetting the girls in reception who are so lovely.If you are looking for a Veterinary Hospital with EXCELLENT care this is the place for you!!

I found a freshly ran over dog late at night and called the nearest vet. They asked if I can bring the dog to them and when I said no because it is on a road and keeps getting ran over by cars they just told me to take a picture of the dog and send it to a lost&found. I was waiting but they never came to recover the body. Absolutely disgraceful. I am terribly sorry to the owners. It was someone’s beloved missing pet and me as a regular citizen don’t know what to do with unexpectedly seeing a corpse of a dog on the street hence why called for nearest help which never came.

What can I say ….
Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts for all the great care you have given us over the years and hopefully will do for many years to come
The compassion shown was second to none
And the personal touch was only amazing thank you Elaine and Delia 🌹
Thank you Dermot and Joe and all the vets there we really appreciate all you have done
And behind the scenes to all the staff thank you 🐾🌟

I went there twice with little pigeons, and every time they were incredibly kind and welcoming. I didn’t have to pay anything for bringing the birds, and even once when I arrived around midnight, they received me with a smile. Truly caring and wonderful people.

Blackpool vetanary hospital has shown our poodle Nellie the greatest care, we travel over two hour to get there and it's worth every minute they are so kind and even remembered her name, I will be eternally grateful for there skill and expertise curing Nellie's broken leg.
I thoroughly recommend this pet's hospital
Very friendly staff & my two foster dogs received excellent care.

I just wanted share my amazing experience with Blackpool Veterinary Hospital , my staffie went in for an operation and due to no Fault of my own , my little staffie ended up getting gastroenteritis, he was in and out of the vet and the level of care was absolutely amazing, they really do make you feel like they stand for animal care befor profit and I just cannot recommend all the staff there enough, From the moment we walked in, they treated us with compassion, urgency, and genuine care,they always took the time to explain everything clearly, never rushed us, and made sure we understood all our options. What stood out most was their incredible dedication—they stayed after hours to monitor my staffie (my child) and even checked in with me personally to let me know how he was doing. They really are the most amazing vet and staff and so greatfull that my dogs are always treated by the very best ❤️ thank you to everyone at Blackpool Veterinary Hospital!
Joe is an amazing vet. So patient and thoughtful. Explains everything and always follows up even if it's a small question. The receptionists are amazing as well, so responsive and welcoming!
My dog Alfie got his teeth done yesterday.(Thanks Amy and team) He was so well looked after and wanted to go home with the girl on reception after she was nice to him.

Just picked my nelly my 15 month old standard poodle, her foreleg was broken and the team at B,V,H, looked after her they gave me daily updates  and gave me written as well as oral instructions they even liaised with Nelly's own vet concerning post operation.
Give this veterinary hospital my highest gratitude.
Thank you
Dennis Jones

extremely disappointing and frustrating experience where there was absolutely zero care for the known existing issues with my pet - the sole reason for attending this place was to get to the bottom of the ongoing issues. we have been left back at square one, i still have a sick puppy and no answers no reassurance no advice no tests done no treatment offered.
100% we did attend Blackpool Veterinary Hospital. Rudy is now on treatment that is working for him thankfully but is unfortunately maybe a treatment that he will need to continue to be on.
It is just very wrong to pay for a service that provided no care at all.

We ended up here in an emergency and despite having no dealings with them before, everyone we met was so unbelievably kind and professional. This resulted in a few visits with a sad outcome but we knew that we were doing the right thing and felt great support and compassion from each vet - thank you Joe, Cathal and Michael. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.

Reception:
I went today to get my cat cremated today 25/04/25. Reception was busy, a lot of people and a few dogs. I was a bit emotional as I handed her over to the girl on reception. I can’t say enough about this girl, she made me feel like I was the only person there, I cremated a 16 year old cat in November in another vets and it was a cold experience I didn’t want to leave her I didn’t feel the staff there cared but this girl made the situation a lot easier for me.
Bru used a dog syringe on my rabbit (keyhole)
My dog was suffering and I brought it here and it passed away shortly after being in here I’m so disappointed in this place

My experience at Blackpool Veterinary Hospital was a positive one. We were seen at very short notice with our sick hamster. Unfortunately,  he didn't make it but everything was done to try and save him. I'd like to thank Joe our vet particularly for being so kind and understanding and professional.
The cost was also reasonable and even though our little hamster didn't make it, we felt looked after.

We can't recommend Michael and the team at Blackpool highly enough.  We were apprehensive about taking our cat to an out of hours service as he has a complex pre existing condition, but instantly Michael was fully aware of our cat's needs.  Michael was super friendly, kind, professional and incredibly reassuring in his approach, both to us and our cat!
The facilities this practice has are superb and it was so good to have in house blood results etc within the hour.  We really were impressed with the level of care and service we received, especially on a Sunday evening of a long weekend when many facilities are usually unavailable.
We wouldn't hesitate to use Blackpool Veterinary Hospital again.
Thank you Michael.

Excellent vets! My dog got spayed (keyhole) there last week and she was back to herself after 2 days as if she never got surgery. The women at the front desk were so friendly and helpful from the first call.
Nicest vets I've ever delt with and the girls at the counter were extremely helpful I would highly recommend
It has a very good name and is very useful for the North Side community, and not only that - places like this are needed all over the city to treat our animals.
Was only Making an inquiry.the Secretary on the phone was os helpfully.Thanks for your time Very much appreciated..
Most humane and caring vets iv ever had the pleasure to deal with.iv had dogs all my life .so have used vets forever.but Blackpool vets are a class act .thank you guys xx
Fantastic vets Joe is brilliant very knowledgeable with any animal all the staff are very helpful and friendly any of my animals are always in excellent care thank you 👌 …

Excellent care. I brought a wild injured bird and the vet assessed and cleaned it up without charge, helped me get in contact with a bird charity to house the bird whilst it recovered, and gave me excellent advice on caring for the bird until it could be handed over to the charity. Not all animal hospitals would extend such attention and time to a wild animal that is not someone's personal domesticated pet, but the vet's here treated it as they would any other patient. I cannot praise the service and support here enough.
